run.question:
Alertmanager alert RequestErrorRate (severity warning) is firing for service otel-demo/frontend since 2026-11-17T09:33:37Z.
Investigate why this alert is firing.

report.summary: The frontend alert is real and confined to the checkout path: frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans appear on span_name 'POST /api/checkout' (and its child 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder') from the 09:33:37Z sample onward at 0.29-0.42 spans/s, after being 0 at every sample from 09:11:37Z through 09:31:37Z. The same failure appears one hop down as error spans on checkout ('HTTP POST', 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder') and shipping ('/get-quote' server, 'POST quote' client), while quote's span rate collapses from ~1.1-1.6 spans/s to 0.10-0.23 spans/s and frontend-proxy records 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' error spans. The timeline matches a chaos-mesh experiment: Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' in namespace chaos-mesh began spawning a NetworkChaos object every minute at 09:31:39Z, and the PodNetworkChaos records name exactly shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and both quote pods (quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b, quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt). Shipping logs show repeated 'Requesting quote' without completion lines, while quote kept logging 'Calculated quote' and recorded no ERROR span; every otel-demo pod is Running/ready with 0 restarts. The evidence therefore points to a partition on the shipping->quote edge injected by that Schedule, with quote not internally failing; because the chaos custom resources' specs could not be read, the cause identity rests on Kubernetes events and is stated as a hypothesis, so the conclusion is partial. Background flagd EventStream errors on ad, fraud-detection and recommendation predate the deviation and are not part of this failure.

claims.text: frontend STATUS_CODE_ERROR spans are 0 for every sample from 09:11:37Z to 09:31:37Z, then non-zero from the 09:33:37Z sample through 09:41:37Z on span_name 'POST /api/checkout' (0.3446775 at 09:35:37Z, 0.3888889 at 09:37:37Z, 0.3 at 09:39:37Z, 0.2888889 at 09:41:37Z), identically on 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout'; all other frontend span_names (GET /, GET /api/cart, GET /api/data, GET /api/products/{productId}, GET /api/recommendations, POST /api/cart) stay at 0 error rate.

Non-frontend ERROR span rates are non-zero only for checkout span_names 'HTTP POST' and 'oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' (0.3888889 at 09:35:37Z to 0.4085067 at 09:41:37Z), shipping span_names '/get-quote' and 'POST quote' (0.3888889 at 09:35:37Z to 0.3957408 at 09:41:37Z), frontend-proxy span_names 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' (0.3702092 at 09:33:37Z to 0.3957408 at 09:41:37Z), plus sparse flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream errors on ad (0.0111111/s at 09:25:37Z and 09:35:37Z), fraud-detection (0.0127658/s at 09:27:37Z, 0.0111111/s at 09:37:37Z) and recommendation '/flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/EventStream' (0.0122342/s at 09:11:37Z, 0.0111111/s at 09:21:37Z, 0.0127658/s at 09:41:37Z).

quote's span rate falls from 1.098-1.60 spans/s across samples 09:11:37Z-09:31:37Z to 0.2298 at 09:33:37Z and 0.10-0.23 spans/s through 09:41:37Z, while checkout STATUS_CODE_ERROR runs 0.6-0.8170/s and shipping STATUS_CODE_ERROR 0.6-0.7915/s; quote has only a STATUS_CODE_UNSET series and no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series in this window, and shipping's UNSET rate falls over the same interval from ~1.07-1.63/s to 0.10-0.23/s.

Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' in namespace chaos-mesh emitted Spawned events every minute from 09:31:39Z through 09:41:39Z, each with message 'Create new object: otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-<suffix>', and in the same events the PodNetworkChaos records begin at 09:31:39Z for exactly shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9, quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b and quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt.

All NetworkChaos event objects in the retained window are named 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-*' (10 distinct instances, 64 events, reasons Applied/Recovered/Started/TimeUp/Updated/FinalizerInited); the newest, otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition-kx8th, started at 09:41:39Z with Applied messages 'Successfully apply chaos for otel-demo/shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9', '... for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt' and '... for otel-demo/quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b'; its predecessor xb6sh started 09:40:39Z and reached 'Time up according to the duration' plus Recovered for the same three pods at 09:41:34Z.

All 22 pods in otel-demo are phase Running and ready with restartCount 0 and empty lastState, including frontend-675fd7b5c5-d2vwq, shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and both quote pods quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b and quote-6b5877698d-x9hwt.

The 'quote' Service has two populated endpoint addresses (100.96.2.155 and 100.96.4.53, port 8080) and 'shipping' has endpoint 100.96.4.227:8080, so the endpoint objects on both sides of the failing edge are populated.

Shipping container logs between 09:35:22Z and 09:36:24Z are dominated by repeated 'Requesting quote' lines, with only a few 'Sending Quote' plus 'Tracking ID Created' pairs (e.g. at 09:35:34-09:35:36Z), i.e. most quote requests in that interval started and never reached the completion log line.
The quote container's own log continues to emit 'Calculated quote' lines from 09:30:18.579Z through 09:41:36.171Z (422 lines read), showing quote kept serving some requests during the incident.

Across all namespaces the only Warning events in the retained window are 1 PersistentVolume 'VolumeFailedDelete' (namespace null) and 2 Pod 'FailedScheduling' in namespace data-recorders; there are no Warning events for otel-demo pods (no Evicted, OOMKilling or Unhealthy), and the events are dominated by chaos-mesh NetworkChaos/Schedule records (126 NetworkChaos Updated, 33 Applied, 30 Recovered, 11 Started, 10 TimeUp) and 63 otel-demo PodNetworkChaos Updated records.

The recurring partition declared by chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' (spawning a NetworkChaos every minute from 09:31:39Z and applying chaos to shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 and both quote pods) blocks shipping's outbound quote calls; this fits shipping 'POST quote' errors, quote's span-rate collapse to ~15% of baseline with no ERROR status on quote's own spans, and frontend/checkout/frontend-proxy errors that begin in the first sample after the first chaos round.

Remaining alternative not excluded: a fault on the shipping->quote edge other than the named chaos experiment (for example DNS resolution or a block enforced by another network layer) could produce the same symptoms; the Schedule's and NetworkChaos objects' specs (direction, selector, duration) could not be read, so declared fault details rest on object names and event messages only.

Pod crash, OOMKill or container restart of frontend, checkout, shipping or quote as the cause is rejected: all otel-demo pods are Running and ready with restartCount 0 and empty lastState, and no Evicted/OOMKilling/Unhealthy Warning events exist for otel-demo in the retained event window.

The flagd EventStream errors on ad (0.0111111/s), fraud-detection (0.0127658/s) and recommendation (0.0122342/s) are not the cause of this alert: they already appear at 09:11:37Z, 09:21:37Z, 09:25:37Z and 09:27:37Z, before the error signal deviated in the 09:31:37-09:33:37Z samples, and none of them is on frontend's, checkout's, shipping's or frontend-proxy's error series.

quote did not fail internally: its span series carry only STATUS_CODE_UNSET with no STATUS_CODE_ERROR series, its container kept logging 'Calculated quote' through 09:41:36.171Z, its pod is ready with 0 restarts, and its Service still exposes two endpoint addresses (100.96.2.155, 100.96.4.53); the observable change is loss of traffic to quote, not errors emitted by quote.

Inspect the chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' spec (target selector, direction, duration, schedule) and decide whether this recurring shipping<->quote partition is intended fault injection or should be suspended, since a new round has been injected every minute since at least 09:31:39Z.

Verify the Alertmanager 'RequestErrorRate' rule definition against the Prometheus that actually evaluates it, because list_prometheus_rules with rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no rules on this target, so the expression behind the alert annotation's 'current: 1.111111111111111' is unconfirmed.

gaps: The chaos-mesh Schedule and NetworkChaos resources could not be read (their kinds were not queried and no view returned their specs), so the partition's direction, pod selector, duration and the Schedule's creation time are known only from object names and event messages.
The change_history integration is not available in this Run, so who or what created Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' and when cannot be established.

Jaeger does not cover the incident: traces_search for frontend over 09:30:00Z-09:49:25Z returned no traces (view 7b34d037-6b8c-41b0-9190-130a08ee6040-t0:8f128a17-6794-4bbe-965c-6a9dea655d92 has no data), and traces_search for shipping returned spans only up to about 09:17:43Z (an over-large result was not fully read), so the 'POST quote' span's own error code/message is unknown.

The exact error text for the failing shipping->quote call is unknown: error-filtered log reads of shipping-75d58f5d84-6xkt9 (2866 lines read, 0 matched) and quote-6b5877698d-sdl5b (422 lines read, 0 matched) returned nothing, and the checkout read (5431 lines, 0 matched) also returned nothing.
list_prometheus_rules for rule_name RequestErrorRate returned no rules on this target, so the alerting expression and threshold could not be verified.

A networkpolicies query for otel-demo returned no rows, so whether any NetworkPolicy exists in that namespace is unknown and NetworkPolicy misconfiguration can be neither confirmed nor excluded from this source.
No ERROR-status metric series was returned for quote, so whether quote recorded errors of its own is unknown rather than zero; its span series carried only STATUS_CODE_UNSET.

Metric series for cart, product-catalog, payment, currency, email, accounting, image-provider, kafka, load-generator and otel-collector were not examined individually, so these services are not certified healthy here.
Latency of the affected calls was not compared against a baseline, so no latency trend is claimed.
next_steps: Read the chaos-mesh Schedule 'otel-demo-shipping-quote-network-partition' and its NetworkChaos children to confirm target selector, direction, duration and schedule.
Confirm with the platform owner whether the shipping<->quote network partition experiment is intentional; if not, suspend the Schedule and re-check the frontend POST /api/checkout error rate.
Locate the RequestErrorRate rule in the Prometheus/Alertmanager that evaluates it and confirm the reported 1.111111111111111 is the frontend request error rate the annotation describes.
Capture a failing shipping->quote call at the network or gRPC layer to distinguish connection reset/timeout from DNS or other causes on that edge.

query.jq_expr: .items[] | select(.involvedObject.kind=="Schedule" or (.involvedObject.kind=="PodNetworkChaos" and .reason=="Updated")) | {kind: .involvedObject.kind, name: .involvedObject.name, ns: .involvedObject.namespace, reason, first: .firstTimestamp, message} | [.] | sort_by(.first) | .[]
